title: THE BELT CAPTION DRAWS KEYCAPS
why: His orders of 2026-10-12: redo the HUD (#35) and make it look like a triple A game (#50). Its keys are keycaps now, on the same graphite as the panels. The words, place and size are the same.
now: The caption over the belt shows its keys as keycaps.
